Each button re-sends the complete A/C state over infrared, exactly as the original Mitsubishi handset does, so the on-screen display always matches what was transmitted.

• ON/OFF — powers the unit on or off
• MODE — cools, heats, dries, fan only, auto
• TEMP — 16 °C to 31 °C (not used in DRY or FAN)
• WIND SPEED — auto, four steps, silent
• SWING — sweeps the vane up and down

Transmission needs a phone with an IR blaster. Without one the display and buttons still work, so the layout can be checked on any device.

“Mitsubishi” covers several incompatible IR encodings, and a unit ignores frames from the wrong one. If the A/C does not react, switch code set below and press ON/OFF again — the unit beeps when it understands a frame.
